class Base; def label; 'base'; end; end
class Child < Base; end
bound = Child.new.public_method(:label)
raise 'wrong executed implementation' unless bound.call == 'base'
bound.owner.name + '#label'

module Stamp; def label; 'stamp'; end; end
class Parcel; prepend Stamp; def label; 'parcel'; end; end
bound = Parcel.new.public_method(:label)
raise 'wrong executed implementation' unless bound.call == 'stamp'
bound.owner.name + '#label'

module Stamp; def label; 'stamp'; end; end
class Base; def label; 'base'; end; end
class Child < Base; include Stamp; end
bound = Child.new.public_method(:label)
raise 'wrong executed implementation' unless bound.call == 'stamp'
bound.owner.name + '#label'

module First; def label; 'first'; end; end
module Last; def label; 'last'; end; end
class Parcel; include First; include Last; end
bound = Parcel.new.public_method(:label)
raise 'wrong executed implementation' unless bound.call == 'last'
bound.owner.name + '#label'

class Base; def self.label; 'base'; end; end
class Child < Base; end
bound = Child.public_method(:label)
raise 'wrong executed implementation' unless bound.call == 'base'
bound.owner.to_s.sub(/\A#<Class:(.*)>\z/, '\1') + '.label'

class Parcel; private; def label; 'private'; end; end
begin
  Parcel.new.label
  'unexpected public call'
rescue NoMethodError => error
  raise unless error.name == :label
  nil
end
